draft.subject: Priya Nair suggested we speak
draft.body:
Hi Helen,

Priya Nair mentioned you're looking at AI for client work, so I thought I'd write. I saw Ashby Kerr is hiring a knowledge management lawyer for its precedent bank, which usually means know-how spread across several systems.

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture.

Is keeping that work in-house on your radar?

claims.text: Priya Nair mentioned you're looking at AI for client work
Ashby Kerr is hiring a knowledge management lawyer for its precedent bank
We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture

evidence.text: Knowledge Management Lawyer (part time). Maintain our precedent bank and know-how for the private client and property teams.

facts.wording: Built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture (Legal AI).
The Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) warning notice of 17 August 2026 allows client data into AI tools only with contractual, technical and organisational safeguards.
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
